# transpose

<link-summary>Swaps the rows and columns of a matrix.</link-summary>

<web-summary>transpose() — Swaps the rows and columns of a matrix. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/array</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function transpose(arr: unknown): Array<Array<unknown>>;
```

The value at row `i`, column `j` of the input is at row `j`, column `i` of the result. A new matrix is built; the
input is not modified.

The input must be a matrix with uniform row lengths — the rule
[`isConsistent2DArray`](isConsistent2DArray.md) states — since a ragged input has no transpose. Anything else throws
a plain `Error`.

In a spreadsheet this is the conversion between the two shapes a range comes in: a column read as one row per cell,
and a single row holding the same values.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description                              |
| :-------- | :-------- | :--------------------------------------- |
| `arr`     | `unknown` | The matrix to transpose. Left untouched. |

## Returns

`Array<Array<unknown>>` — a new matrix with the rows and columns swapped. Element types are preserved.

## Throws

| Exception | Condition                                                |
| :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Error`   | The input is not a matrix, or its rows differ in length. |

## Examples

### Rows become columns

```javascript
transpose([
  [1, 2, 3],
  [4, 5, 6]
]);
// => [
//   [1, 4],
//   [2, 5],
//   [3, 6]
// ]
```

### Writing a list down a column

`setValues` wants one row per cell to fill a column, and a flat list is not that shape.

<tabs group="code">
<tab title="TypeScript" group-key="ts">
<code-block lang="typescript" src="transpose.ts" include-symbol="writeColumn"/>
</tab>
<tab title="JavaScript" group-key="js">
<code-block lang="javascript">
function writeColumn(sheet, values) {
  const column = transpose([values]);
  sheet.getRange(1, 1, column.length, 1).setValues(column);
}
</code-block>
</tab>
</tabs>

### Invalid input

```javascript
transpose([1, 2, 3]); // throws Error: Input must be a 2D array.
transpose([[1, 2], [3]]); // throws Error: Input must be a 2D array.
```
